name.zh: 糧倉在飛魚終食前達到「剛好」
name.en: Get the food store "just right" before the flying fish season ends

text.coopEn: No need to be there together

steps.text: 請主人家的女性長輩看看糧倉
steps.textEn: Ask the host family's woman elder to check the food store

lines.zh: 飛魚乾、芋頭都收進來了，我們數一數。
lines.en: The dried flying fish and taro are all in. Let's count.

lines.zh: 夠吃到飛魚終食之前，不多也不少。剛好，就是最好的。
lines.en: Enough to last until the flying fish season ends — not too much, not too little. Just right is best.

lines.zh: 「剛好」：不浪費，也不缺。多的分給親族，少的大家一起補。
lines.en: "Just right": no waste, nothing missing. Extra goes to relatives; if we're short, everyone helps.

toast: 糧倉在飛魚終食前達到「剛好」。
toastEn: The food store is "just right" before the flying fish season ends.

hint.zh: 飛魚乾和芋頭都收好了，請主人家的女性長輩看看糧倉。
hint.en: The dried flying fish and taro are stored. Ask the host family's woman elder to check the food store.

name.en: Share taro with three related families

steps.text: 主人家的女性長輩交代：把芋頭分給三戶親族
steps.textEn: The host family's woman elder asks: share taro with three related families

lines.zh: 今年田裡收得好。採三顆水芋，送去三戶親戚家。
lines.en: The field gave well this year. Pick three taro and take them to three relatives' homes.

lines.zh: 送的時候說是我們家給的，他們就知道了。
lines.en: When you give them, say it's from our family. They'll understand.

steps.text: 到家裡的水芋田採三顆水芋
steps.textEn: Pick three taro in the family's taro field

lines.zh: 挑大顆的，一家一顆。
lines.en: Pick the big ones, one per family.

steps.text: 送一顆水芋到椰油的親戚家
steps.textEn: Take a taro to the relatives in Yayo

lines.zh: 主人家給的啊？替我謝謝她。
lines.en: From the host family? Please thank her for me.

alt.text: 送一顆水芋到東清的親戚家
alt.textEn: Take a taro to the relatives in Iranmeylek

lines.zh: 主人家給的啊？替我謝謝她。
lines.en: From the host family? Please thank her for me.

steps.text: 送一顆水芋到朗島的親戚家
steps.textEn: Take a taro to the relatives in Iraraley

lines.zh: 今年的芋頭真好。下次換我們送過去。
lines.en: This year's taro is great. Next time we'll bring some to you.

alt.text: 送一顆水芋到漁人的親戚家
alt.textEn: Take a taro to the relatives in Iratay

lines.zh: 今年的芋頭真好。下次換我們送過去。
lines.en: This year's taro is great. Next time we'll bring some to you.

steps.text: 送一顆水芋到野銀的親戚家
steps.textEn: Take a taro to the relatives in Ivalino

lines.zh: 收到了。田裡的東西，要大家一起吃才香。
lines.en: Got it. Food from the fields tastes best when everyone shares it.

alt.text: 送一顆水芋到紅頭的親戚家
alt.textEn: Take a taro to the relatives in Imorod

lines.zh: 收到了。田裡的東西，要大家一起吃才香。
lines.en: Got it. Food from the fields tastes best when everyone shares it.

steps.text: 回主人家回報
steps.textEn: Report back to the host family

lines.zh: 都送到了？好。親戚之間就是這樣，你來我往。
lines.en: All delivered? Good. That's how it is between relatives — give and take.

toast: 三戶親族都收到了主人家的芋頭。
toastEn: All three related families received taro from the host family.

hint.zh: 收成之後，主人家的女性長輩會請族人把芋頭分給親族。
hint.en: After the harvest, the host family's woman elder will ask you to share taro with relatives.

review: 分送芋頭給親族的習慣（送給哪些人家、一次送多少）請族人確認

name.en: Mend a fishing net with the Tao man

text.whoEn: Traveller (more content for a male traveller)

steps.text: 旅人和族男一起到開元港，問拼板舟漁人有沒有網要補
steps.textEn: The traveller and the Tao man go to Kaiyuan Harbour and ask the plank boat fisher if any nets need mending

lines.zh: 這張網破了好幾個洞，你們來得剛好。
lines.en: This net has quite a few holes. Good timing.

lines.zh: 族男補大洞，旅人補小的。照你學過的結打。
lines.en: The Tao man mends the big holes, the traveller the small ones. Tie the knots the way you learned.

steps.text: 在港邊一起補網
steps.textEn: Mend the net together by the harbour

lines.zh: 先把破掉的線頭修齊，再一格一格補回去。
lines.en: First trim the broken ends, then mend it back one square at a time.

lines.zh: 這次的結比上次緊多了！
lines.en: These knots are much tighter than last time!

steps.text: 把補好的網交還
steps.textEn: Hand back the mended net

lines.zh: 補得不錯。網補好了，船組下次出海就用得上。
lines.en: Nice work. With the net mended, the boat crew can use it next time they go out.

toast: 旅人和族男一起補好一張漁網。
toastEn: The traveller and the Tao man mended a fishing net together.

hint.zh: 學過結網之後，可以和族男去開元港，幫拼板舟漁人補網。
hint.en: After learning to knot nets, you can go with the Tao man to Kaiyuan Harbour and help the plank boat fisher mend nets.

name.zh: 整理 10 張圖鑑卡給族語老師看
name.en: Show 10 field guide cards to the Tao language teacher

text.unlockEn: Food words added to the Tao word cards

steps.text: 把圖鑑卡帶給族語老師
steps.textEn: Bring the field guide cards to the Tao language teacher

lines.zh: 你們的圖鑑卡帶來了？我們一起看，哪些東西有族語的名字。
lines.en: You brought your field guide cards? Let's see together which things have Tao names.

lines.zh: 族語名字不確定的，先空著，等族人告訴我們，不要自己猜。
lines.en: If we're not sure of a Tao name, leave it blank until the community tells us. Don't guess.

steps.text: 在學校把十張圖鑑卡排在桌上，一張一張對
steps.textEn: At the school, lay the ten cards on the table and match them one by one

lines.zh: 水芋是 soli，飛魚是 alibangbang，螃蟹是 kalang。
lines.en: Taro is soli, flying fish is alibangbang, crab is kalang.

steps.text: 聽老師說明食物詞
steps.textEn: Listen to the teacher explain the food words

lines.zh: 會叫食物的名字，就會想知道它是怎麼來的。下次帶長輩說的話來。
lines.en: Once you can name a food, you'll want to know where it comes from. Next time, bring what the elders say.

toast: 族語詞卡加上了食物詞。
toastEn: Food words were added to the Tao word cards.

hint.zh: 族語老師想看看你們收集的圖鑑卡，帶去椰油的學校。
hint.en: The Tao language teacher wants to see the field guide cards you've collected. Take them to the Yayo school.

name.zh: 數一數路邊的陸蟹並回報（不抓）
name.en: Count the land crabs by the road and report back (no catching)

text.unlockEn: Nature points, land crab care card

steps.text: 晚上在路邊數陸蟹（只看、不抓、不用強光照）
steps.textEn: Count land crabs by the road at night (look only — no catching, no bright lights)

lines.zh: 一、二、三……這段路上有七隻。
lines.en: One, two, three… seven on this stretch of road.

lines.zh: 用紅光或微弱的光看就好，不要抓，也不要擋住牠們的路。
lines.en: Use a red or dim light. Don't catch them or block their way.

steps.text: 回家告訴長輩數到的數量
steps.textEn: Go home and tell the elder how many you counted

lines.zh: 七隻啊。牠們每年都走同一條路，我們讓一讓就好。
lines.en: Seven, eh? They take the same path every year. We just make way for them.

hint.zh: 陸蟹季的晚上，西岸路邊常有陸蟹經過，數一數就好。
hint.en: On land crab season nights, crabs often cross the west coast road. Just count them.

name.zh: 隱藏：替族語老師錄一段長輩的話（先問同意）
name.en: Hidden: record an elder's words for the Tao language teacher (ask first)

steps.text: 在涼亭上，旅人和族人一起先問長輩能不能錄音
steps.textEn: On the pavilion, the traveller and a Tao member first ask the elder if it's okay to record

lines.zh: 可以幫族語老師錄一段您說的話嗎？只給學校教族語用。
lines.en: Could we record a few of your words for the Tao language teacher? Only for teaching Tao at school.

lines.zh: 要錄什麼？
lines.en: Record what?

lines.zh: 一句問候就好。您不想錄，我們就不錄。
lines.en: Just a greeting. If you'd rather not, we won't record.

lines.zh: 問候可以。故事等我想一想，有些不是每個人都能聽的。
lines.en: A greeting is fine. The stories — let me think. Some aren't for everyone to hear.

lines.zh: akokey。

steps.text: 把錄音交給族語老師
steps.textEn: Give the recording to the Tao language teacher

lines.zh: 謝謝你們先問過長輩。錄音我會好好保存，只在課堂上用。
lines.en: Thank you for asking the elder first. I'll keep the recording safe and only use it in class.

toast: 長輩同意錄下一句問候。故事，等長輩願意說的時候。
toastEn: The elder agreed to record a greeting. The stories can wait until the elder wants to tell them.

hint.zh: 族語老師說，要是能聽到長輩親口說的族語就好了……但一定要先問過。
hint.en: The Tao language teacher says it would be great to hear Tao from an elder's own voice… but always ask first.

review: 替族語老師錄長輩說話的情節：先問同意、只錄問候、故事不是每個人都能聽；請族人確認是否恰當

name.zh: 隱藏：營養師的飲食小調查
name.en: Hidden: the dietitian's little food survey

steps.text: 營養師請大家記一週吃了什麼，先問主人家
steps.textEn: The dietitian asks everyone to note what they eat for a week. Ask the host family first

lines.zh: 這一週吃什麼？芋頭、地瓜、魚，還有一些麵。忙的時候就吃快一點的。
lines.en: What do we eat in a week? Taro, sweet potato, fish, and some noodles. When we're busy, we eat something quick.

steps.text: 把一週的飲食交給營養師
steps.textEn: Give the week's food notes to the dietitian

lines.zh: 芋頭、地瓜、魚和海菜，加上一些麵和米，這就是現在島上很多家的餐桌。
lines.en: Taro, sweet potato, fish and seaweed, plus some noodles and rice — that's the table in many island homes today.

lines.zh: 傳統的食物本來就很均衡。少一點泡麵，多一點田裡和海裡的東西就好。
lines.en: Traditional food is already well balanced. A bit less instant noodles, a bit more from the fields and the sea, and you're good.

toast: 營養師的飲食小調查完成。
toastEn: The dietitian's food survey is done.

hint.zh: 營養師好像在找人幫忙做飲食調查。
hint.en: The dietitian seems to be looking for help with a food survey.

name.zh: 隱藏：潮池生物觀察（只看不採）
name.en: Hidden: tide pool watching (look, don't pick)

steps.text: 退潮時，族女帶旅人觀察潮池（只看不採）
steps.textEn: At low tide, the Tao woman shows the traveller the tide pools (look, don't pick)

lines.zh: 蹲低一點看。石頭翻過來看完，要放回原來的地方。
lines.en: Crouch down to look. After turning a stone, put it back where it was.

lines.zh: 有海星、小魚，還有寄居蟹。我只拍，不拿。
lines.en: There are starfish, little fish and hermit crabs. I'll just take photos, not take anything.

toastEn: Looked without picking. Nature points up.

hint.zh: 常常準時在退潮時到海邊的人，會發現潮池裡有好多東西。
hint.en: People who often reach the shore right at low tide will find lots of life in the tide pools.

name.zh: 隱藏：在學校辦島嶼照片小展
name.en: Hidden: a small island photo show at the school

text.pre: 相簿任 6 張（收集門檻）
text.unlock: 部落關係、族語詞卡加地名
text.unlockEn: Village ties, place names added to Tao word cards

steps.text: 族語老師想在學校辦一個小照片展
steps.textEn: The Tao language teacher wants to hold a small photo show at the school

lines.zh: 你拍了好多島上的照片。可以借學校辦個小展覽嗎？
lines.en: You've taken so many photos of the island. Could the school borrow them for a little show?

lines.zh: 每張照片寫上地方的名字，還有你拍照時守的規矩。
lines.en: Write the place name on each photo, and the rule you kept when you took it.

steps.text: 在學校把照片一張張貼好
steps.textEn: Put up the photos one by one at the school

lines.zh: 這張只在路邊遠拍；這張先問過屋主。
lines.en: This one I only took from the roadside; for this one I asked the owner first.

lines.zh: 孩子們圍過來，指著照片說出部落的名字。
lines.en: The kids gather round, pointing at the photos and naming the villages.

steps.text: 展覽完成
steps.textEn: Show finished

lines.zh: 孩子們說，原來外面的人也會這樣看我們的島。謝謝你。
lines.en: The kids say they didn't know outsiders saw our island like this. Thank you.

toast: 族語詞卡加上地名。部落關係提升。
toastEn: Place names added to the Tao word cards. Village ties up.

hint.zh: 族語老師聽說旅人拍了很多照片。
hint.en: The Tao language teacher heard the traveller took lots of photos.

name.zh: 文化工作者講海岸地名的故事（內容待確認）
name.en: The culture worker tells stories of coastal place names (content to be confirmed)

text.pre: B1 且 相簿「北岸奇岩」一套
text.preEn: B1 and the album set "North coast rocks"
text.unlock: 故事卡（待族人提供）、族語詞卡加地名
text.unlockEn: Story card (from the community), place names added to Tao word cards

steps.text: 旅人帶著照片，聽部落文化工作者說海岸地名
steps.textEn: The traveller brings the photos and hears the culture worker talk about coastal place names

lines.zh: 你拍的這些，什麼岩、什麼洞，很多是外面的人看形狀取的名字。
lines.en: All these — this rock, that cave — many of the names were given by outsiders, based on shapes.

lines.zh: 族人對每個海角、每塊礁石都有自己的名字，有的記著誰在那裡上岸，誰在那裡曬過衣服。
lines.en: The Tao people have their own name for every cape and every reef — some remember who landed there, or who once dried clothes there.

lines.zh: 這幾年，部落的年輕人一塊石頭一塊石頭地，把名字和故事找回來。
lines.en: In recent years, the village's young people have been bringing the names and stories back, one rock at a time.

lines.zh: 名字和故事，要由部落自己說。等族人同意，我再一個一個告訴你。
lines.en: Names and stories should be told by the village itself. When the community agrees, I'll tell you one by one.

lines.zh: 我會在相簿裡先留一欄，等族人來寫。
lines.en: I'll leave a space in the album for the community to fill in.

toast: 相簿照片加上「族語地名」欄，等族人提供。
toastEn: Album photos now have a "Tao place name" space, waiting for the community.

hint.zh: 拍過北岸的奇岩之後，部落文化工作者想跟旅人聊聊這些地方的名字。
hint.en: After you photograph the north coast rocks, the village culture worker wants to talk with the traveller about the names of these places.

review: 海岸地名的說法（觀光名多為外人依形狀取名；部落青年的地景正名）取自公開資料；族語地名與故事要由族人提供，遊戲目前不列出

name.zh: 找到正在野外調查的地質學家（❗ 會移動）
name.en: Find the geologist doing fieldwork (❗ moves around)

text.unlock: 相簿照片的地質筆記欄、岩石圖鑑、D2
text.unlockEn: Geology notes in the album, rock field guide, D2

steps.text: 找到正在野外調查的地質學家
steps.textEn: Find the geologist doing fieldwork

lines.zh: 你們找到我了！我在調查海岸的岩石，每天都換地方。
lines.en: You found me! I'm studying the coastal rocks, and I'm somewhere new every day.

lines.zh: 想一起看嗎？我可以教你們怎麼看石頭。
lines.en: Want to look together? I can show you how to read rocks.

toast: 相簿照片加上地質筆記欄。
toastEn: Album photos now have a geology notes space.

hint.zh: 有個拿著放大鏡的地質學家在島上到處跑，今天不知道在哪。
hint.en: A geologist with a magnifying glass runs all over the island. Who knows where today.

name.zh: 跟地質學家看火山岩海岸
name.en: See the volcanic coast with the geologist

steps.text: 跟地質學家約好去看火山岩海岸
steps.textEn: Arrange with the geologist to see the volcanic coast

lines.zh: 我們去西北岸那塊大岩石，那裡最好看。
lines.en: Let's go to that big rock on the northwest coast. It's the best one.

steps.text: 跟地質學家看火山岩海岸
steps.textEn: See the volcanic coast with the geologist

lines.zh: 這些岩塊是火山噴發的碎屑堆起來的。硬的留下來，軟的被海浪帶走。
lines.en: These blocks are piled-up debris from eruptions. The hard parts stay; the soft parts are carried off by the waves.

lines.zh: 這是地質的看法。族人對這塊岩石有自己的名字和故事，兩種都值得聽。
lines.en: That's the geology view. The Tao people have their own name and story for this rock. Both are worth hearing.

toast: 蘭嶼是海底火山噴發形成的島。
toastEn: Lanyu was formed by an undersea volcano.

hint.zh: 地質學家要帶大家去看火山岩海岸。
hint.en: The geologist wants to take everyone to see the volcanic coast.

name.zh: 從步道與路邊觀察海蝕地形
name.en: Watch sea-carved landforms from the trail and roadside

text.pre: D2 且 相簿「東岸」一套
text.preEn: D2 and the album set "East coast"
text.unlock: 海蝕地質卡、地質學家的隱藏調查紀錄
text.unlockEn: Sea erosion card, the geologist's hidden field notes

steps.text: 從路邊觀察海蝕拱門
steps.textEn: Look at a sea arch from the roadside

lines.zh: 海浪一年一年打進岩縫，縫越來越大，最後就穿成一個拱門。
lines.en: Year after year the waves hit the cracks in the rock. The cracks grow until a hole goes right through — an arch.

lines.zh: 你們拍過的那些岩石，都是這樣被海慢慢雕出來的。站在路邊看就好，崖邊很危險。
lines.en: All the rocks you've photographed were slowly carved by the sea like this. Just look from the road — the cliff edge is dangerous.

steps.text: 地質學家拿出他的調查筆記
steps.textEn: The geologist takes out his field notes

lines.zh: 這本是我的調查紀錄，送你們抄一份。記得，名字還是要問族人。
lines.en: This is my field record. You can copy it. Remember — always ask the Tao people for the names.

toast: 得到地質學家的隱藏調查紀錄。
toastEn: You got the geologist's hidden field notes.

hint.zh: 拍過東岸的奇岩之後，地質學家想帶大家看海蝕地形。
hint.en: After you photograph the east coast rocks, the geologist wants to show everyone the sea-carved landforms.

text.unlock: 旅人視角水下照片組（3 張，只是收藏）
text.unlockEn: Traveller's underwater photo set (3 photos, just to keep)

steps.text: 旅人帶著相機再去母雞岩浮潛，拍一組水下照片
steps.textEn: The traveller takes a camera snorkelling at Hen Rock again for a set of underwater photos

lines.zh: 這次換我用相機拍，珊瑚、魚群都想留下來。
lines.en: This time I'll take the photos. I want to keep the coral and the schools of fish.

toast: 3 張照片已收進「相簿與水下」。

hint.zh: 浮潛的時候帶相機，應該可以拍到很不一樣的畫面。
hint.en: Take a camera when you snorkel. You could get some very different shots.
